# Definition of Done
__Full version in DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md. Check each item once it is fulfilled. Items that do not apply to this PR (e.g. UI items in a backend only change) can be ignored.__

**Before review (author)**
- [ ] All acceptance criteria of the issue are met.
- [ ] The feature works end to end: UI, API and database.
- [ ] Automated tests cover the change.
- [ ] CI passes (lint, type checking, tests and build).
- [ ] Relevant docs are updated (README, API docs, changelog).
- [ ] The page is responsive (mobile and desktop).
- [ ] Protected pages and endpoints require login.
- [ ] Users can only edit or delete their own data.

**Review (reviewer)**
- [ ] Code reviewed and approved.
- [ ] Feature manually tested by someone other than the author.

**After merge**
- [ ] Feature is usable in the staging environment.
